delta1.0526: The weakest graduate job market in the EU: 64% of graduates who left education up to three years ago are in work, against 85% across the EU, although youth unemployment (15.6%) now matches the EU’s. Athens holds 70% of the country’s information and communication jobs and 59% of its finance jobs, and the global industry is shipping: Greek owners control about a fifth of the world’s fleet capacity. A 50% income-tax cut for seven years rewards people who move their tax residence to Greece.
